description: A Minecraft Fabric mod that adds Logistics Worker NPCs capable of executing item-collection and delivery routes across chests and barrels, and Crafting Tasks that direct workers to collect materials, craft items, and deposit the results.

mods.name: NPClogistics
mods.description: Hire NPC workers and assign them work orders to collect and deliver items along chest/barrel routes, or set up automated crafting tasks with source, workbench, and deposit locations.

releases.notes:
---                                                                         
  🎣 v1.1.7 — The Fisherman Update                                            
                                                                              
  New Role: Fisher                                                            
                                                                              
  Equip a worker with a Fishing Rod, a Jobsite Token on the bank where they   
  should stand, and a Deposit Token on an output chest. The fisher walks to   
  the spot, turns to face the water, and gets to work — no further input      
  needed.                                                                     
                                                                              
  Fishing cycle:                                                              
  - Casts the rod (throw sound + arm swing)                                   
  - Waits for a bite (5–10 seconds)                                           
  - Reels in on the bite (splash → retrieve sounds)                           
  - Repeats up to 6 catches, then walks to the chest to deposit               
                                                                              
  Catch table: 60% Raw Cod · 25% Raw Salmon · 13% Tropical Fish · 2%          
  Pufferfish                                                                  
                                                                              
  ---                                                                         
  Farmer Crop Expansions                                                      
                                                                              
  The Farmer role now handles four additional crop types:                     
                                                                              
  Melon, Pumpkin, Sugar Cane & Cactus
